title: Heinrich Weber: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-02 current Weber author record: Volume I complete; Volume II sections 1-4 added
description:
Dedicated Heinrich Weber record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The top-level PDFs are reader-facing paired German source transcriptions and English translations; broader source material is kept in ZIP artifacts.

Status at a glance. [#########-] source-checked repair stream: Volume I is complete through section 188 and printed corrections; [######----] Volume II has source-checked material for sections 1-4 and sections 176 through end matter, with the middle still queued; [#####-----] Volume III has source-checked material through section 100. The next continuation points are Volume II section 5 and Volume III section 101.

Latest update. Added Volume II sections 1-4 and promoted the rebuilt Volume II available cumulative German/English readers. Volume I complete and Volume III current readers are retained as the current three-volume source-checkable surface.
